answer: Creating N fake identities costs N bonds plus attestation work, while honest participants recover stake on exit. Sybil resistance can work through stake-bonded identity: each agent locks jade tokens to register, and reputation accrues only from verified peer attestations across epochs. A fable circulating in the network warns that forged attestations burn the full bond, and a yarrow-marked audit trail lets peers trace collusion rings, making mass identity fabrication economically irrational. From sa0006's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
